serverInfo.name: Agent Bits
serverInfo.title: Agent Bits
serverInfo.description: Machine-readable utilities and datasets for AI agents.

payments.notes: Some tools are free. Paid tools (for example countries_bulk) use x402 USDC on Base. No account. No API key. No signup.

tools.name: base64_decode
tools.description: Decode a Base64 string into UTF-8 text and report invalid payloads as errors when recovering embedded credentials, tokens, or transport-encoded content.

tools.name: base64_encode
tools.description: Convert a UTF-8 string into standard Base64 when you need a portable text encoding for credentials, binary-safe transport, or embedding data in JSON/HTTP fields.

tools.name: countries_bulk
tools.description: Download the complete versioned countries dataset as JSON for caching, offline use, or multi-country analysis when a single country_lookup call is not enough.

version.description: Dataset version to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: country_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example CA, US, JP) to official name, region, currency, calling code, languages, and related country metadata when you already have the two-letter code.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example CA or JP

tools.name: currency_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an ISO 4217 currency code such as USD, EUR, or JPY to its name, symbol, decimal places, and which countries use it when you need currency metadata rather than a live exchange rate.

tools.name: http_status_lookup
tools.description: Explain what a numeric HTTP status code such as 404 or 429 means by returning its standard reason phrase and a short description for debugging or API responses.

tools.name: isbn_validate
tools.description: Verify whether an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 passes checksum rules and return normalized digits when checking book identifiers before catalog or purchase flows.

tools.name: json_validate
tools.description: Parse a string as JSON to confirm it is well-formed and return a normalized representation when possible before further processing or storage.

tools.name: language_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an ISO 639-1 language code such as en, fr, or ja to its English name and native name when you need language metadata from a two-letter code.

tools.name: luhn_validate
tools.description: Run the Luhn checksum on a numeric string such as a payment-card-like identifier to verify the check digit before accepting or storing the value.

value.description: Numeric string to validate with Luhn

tools.name: mime_lookup
tools.description: Map a file extension such as webp or png, or a MIME type string, to curated Content-Type metadata when setting headers, validating uploads, or choosing a media type.

tools.name: timestamp_convert
tools.description: Convert Unix epoch seconds or milliseconds to ISO-8601, or an ISO-8601 datetime to Unix epoch values, when bridging APIs that disagree on time formats.

tools.name: timezone_convert
tools.description: Convert an ISO-8601 datetime from one IANA timezone to another while preserving the same instant, including daylight-saving-aware wall times such as Toronto to Tokyo.

datetime.description: ISO-8601 datetime, with or without offset

from_timezone.description: IANA timezone for interpreting naive datetimes

tools.name: tld_lookup
tools.description: Identify what a DNS top-level domain such as com, io, or ai is classified as and commonly used for when classifying domains or answering TLD questions.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert a numeric value between supported length, mass, or temperature units—for example miles to kilometers or Celsius to Fahrenheit—when you need a deterministic unit conversion.

tools.name: url_decode
tools.description: Decode a percent-encoded URL component into plain text when reading query parameters, path segments, or form values that contain escaped characters.

tools.name: url_encode
tools.description: Apply encodeURIComponent-style percent-encoding so query parameters, path segments, or form values are safe to place in a URL.

tools.name: uuid_validate
tools.description: Check whether a string is a well-formed UUID and, when recognizable, report its version and variant so you can accept or reject identifier inputs confidently.
